scripts.dev: node ../../tooling/development/verify-dev-target.ts && corepack pnpm extensions:build && corepack pnpm extensions:prepare && tauri dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm extensions:build:release && corepack pnpm extensions:prepare:release && tauri build
scripts.dev:computer-use: node ../../tooling/development/verify-dev-target.ts && corepack pnpm extensions:build && corepack pnpm extensions:prepare && tauri build --debug --bundles app && node ../../tooling/development/launch-computer-use-app.ts
scripts.lint: eslint frontend --max-warnings 0 && cd ../.. && eslint --config apps/desktop/eslint.config.mjs tooling --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:fix: eslint frontend --fix && cd ../.. && eslint --config apps/desktop/eslint.config.mjs tooling --fix
scripts.format: dprint fmt && cd ../.. && dprint fmt --config apps/desktop/dprint.json --includes-override "tooling/**/*.ts" "tooling/package.json"
scripts.format:check: dprint check && cd ../.. && dprint check --config apps/desktop/dprint.json --includes-override "tooling/**/*.ts" "tooling/package.json"
